svg.title: C09-M03-F2: What deletion changes (FAT)
svg.desc: Before-and-after rows showing the directory entry first byte changed to E5 and the FAT entry set to free, while the data cluster content is unchanged.
svg.text: BEFORE dir entry: "CUSTOM~1CSV" size=36 first_cluster=N FAT[N]=EOF
data cluster N: "export of customer list..."
AFTER dir entry: 0xE5"USTOM~1CSV" size=36 first_cluster=N FAT[N]=0 (free)
data cluster N: "export of customer list..." <- still there
Figure C09-M03-F2. FAT deletion marks the name and frees the cluster but leaves content
until it is overwritten (consistent with the execution-tested recovery).
